About the Book

A story about becoming yourself.

Henry discovers that life can hold more than one path. Through imagination, challenges and new experiences, he learns that the different sides of who he is can all belong in the same story.

✨ Adventure

Explore new possibilities and imagine what could be.

💙 Friendship

Discover the people and moments that help us grow.

🌟 Self-Discovery

Learn that your story can be uniquely yours.
